newsitem.title: UK: UK consumer indicator at record high for 5th month.
newsitem.headline: UK consumer indicator at record high for 5th month.

text.p: The NTC consumer industries' leading indicator rose again in October, hitting a record high for the fifth consecutive month.

NTC, a specialist provider of business research and information, said upward pressures were being exerted by a tighter labour market, likely to translate into rising wages and real incomes over the next year, strong retail sales growth and the persistence of higher share prices.
The significant growth in output of consumer goods' industries, boosted by buoyant consumer spending also added to upward pressure on the indicator.

The indicator is compiled from a wide range of economic variables, which have tended to give advance indication of turning points in economic activity, usually leading the cycle by around 11 months, NTC said.
NTC said the sharp rise in the indicator over this year points to a drive towards economic expansion next year.
"This suggests a sharp pick up in the rate of gross domestic product growth, driven by higher consumer spending," the report said.
